# Clinical Associates MD

> > A comprehensive multi-specialty medical practice in the Baltimore area offering primary care, specialty services, and urgent care across multiple locations.

Clinical Associates MD operates multiple locations in Towson, Reisterstown, and Woodholme, Maryland, providing integrated primary care and specialty services including cardiology, dermatology, endocrinology, ophthalmology, and podiatry. The practice emphasizes patient-centered care with experienced practitioners and convenient appointment scheduling through NextGen patient portal.

## Specialty Services

- [Heart Care & Cardiology Specialists in Towson](https://clinicalassociatesmd.com/cardiology): Cardiology services including EKG, echocardiograms, and cardiac testing
- [Dermatology & Skin Care Services in Towson](https://clinicalassociatesmd.com/dermatology): Medical and cosmetic dermatology services in Towson
- [Diabetes & Thyroid Care | Endocrinology Experts](https://clinicalassociatesmd.com/endocrinology): Endocrinology care for diabetes, thyroid, and hormonal health
- [Eye Care & Ophthalmology Services in Towson](https://clinicalassociatesmd.com/ophthalmology): Eye care and vision services from Towson ophthalmologists
- [Expert Foot & Ankle Care | Podiatry Services in Towson](https://clinicalassociatesmd.com/podiatry): Podiatry services for foot and ankle conditions in Towson
